sections.title: From bookings to next week’s session.

steps.title: Levels in, courts balanced
steps.body: Each booking brings a skill level. {{brand.name}} plans the rounds so every match is close and all forty players get about the same time on court.

steps.title: Check in, level confirmed
steps.body: Players confirm their level at the door. Walk-ins join the next round, not a queue.

steps.title: A new partner every round
steps.body: Between games, phones buzz with the next court and partner. Scores go in with a tap.

steps.title: Fair court time, counted
steps.body: {{brand.name}} counts every player’s minutes on court. Anyone falling behind goes on next; anyone sitting out is pointed to the lounge, and to someone there to meet.

steps.title: Standings, then the next session
steps.body: Final standings go out with the photos. Players who want an easier or tougher session get that invitation next.

items.question: Does {{brand.name}} book courts?
items.answer: No. You bring the courts, at your venue or one you hire. {{brand.name}} runs the session on them: bookings, levels, rotations, court time and standings.

items.question: Which sports does it work for?
items.answer: Pickleball, padel, badminton and tennis doubles, or anything played in pairs on courts. You set the number of courts and the round length.

items.question: What if the levels are uneven?
items.answer: {{brand.name}} keeps matches as close as the players allow, and counts court time so nobody sits out more than their share.

items.question: What happens with walk-ins?
items.answer: Check them in at the door with a level. They join the next round, and court time stays fair.

items.question: Do players need an app?
items.answer: No. Players book, check in and see their next court in their phone’s browser.

items.question: How is this different from a court-booking app?
items.answer: Court-booking apps help players book courts and find games. {{brand.name}} helps you run a session for a group: levels, rotations, fair court time and bringing players back. Many hosts book the courts in one place and run the session on {{brand.name}}.
